answer: The design leans on sharding with cross-shard communication protocols. Written in a systems thinking, emergent properties highlighted register, it stays short. Work waits on the delta until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the terrace of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nebula of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
